login.headline: Get more bookings for your service in Prayagraj
login.benefitRequests: New booking requests right on your phone
login.benefitPayout: Money in your bank the day after the event
login.title: Log in or register
login.subtitle: Just phone + OTP. Your profile goes live after admin approval.

name.title: What's your name?
name.subtitle: Customers and the EventSeva team will see this name.
name.label: Your name

onboarding.businessSubtitle: Customers will see this on your profile.
onboarding.servicesSubtitle: Add at least one service or package. You can change prices any time.
onboarding.servicesNeeded: Add at least one service or package to continue.

check.services: At least one service or package
check.photos: At least one photo of your work

onboarding.rejectedNoReason: The team did not give a reason.
onboarding.rejectedHelp: Fix the points above, then send it for review again.

pending.title: Your profile is under review
pending.body: The EventSeva team reviews within 24–48 hours, usually sooner. Pull down to check again.

steps.liveSub: Customers can view and book you

pending.lockedNote: Your profile can't be edited while it is being reviewed. Once approved, you can change services, prices and photos any time.

onHold.banner: Your profile is hidden from customers — contact support

home.noRequests: No new requests right now. We'll notify you when one comes in.
home.requestsWaiting: {{n}} new requests are waiting. Answer within 24 hours.
home.noUpcoming: No confirmed bookings coming up yet.

requests.title: Bookings

new.title: No new requests
new.body: New booking requests will show up here. Answer them within 24 hours.

awaitingPayment.title: Nothing waiting for payment
awaitingPayment.body: After you accept a request, the customer has 24 hours to pay the advance.

upcoming.title: No upcoming bookings
upcoming.body: Confirmed bookings with the advance paid will show up here.

past.title: No past bookings
past.body: Finished, cancelled and expired bookings will show up here.

requests.answerWithin: Answer within {{time}}, or the request expires.
requests.waitingPaymentTitle: Waiting for the customer to pay
requests.waitingPaymentBody: The slot is held for you. The customer must pay the advance by {{time}}, or the booking is released.
requests.selectOne: Select a booking to see the details.

booking.title: Booking
booking.phoneAfterConfirm: The customer's phone number is shared once the advance is paid and the booking is confirmed.
booking.cancelBodyPaid: The customer will get 100% of the advance ({{amount}}) back. Cancel only if you really must — customers rely on you.
booking.cancelBodyUnpaid: The customer has not paid yet, so nothing is charged. They will be told to book another vendor.
booking.reportProblem: Report a problem with this booking

money.title: Payment
money.feeNote: Advance {{advance}} paid in the app, minus EventSeva fee {{fee}}.

reason.placeholder: Write a short note for the customer
reason.required: Pick a reason or write one (at least 3 letters).

calendar.title: Calendar

state.overlap: Not available — part of the day is taken

calendar.pickDay: Tap a date to block it or see its bookings.
calendar.blockNote: Dates you block show as "not available" to customers.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyBody: When customers message you about a booking, the chat shows up here.
chat.phoneHint: Phone number is shared after booking is confirmed. Until then, chat in the app.
chat.startHint: Say hello and answer the customer's questions.

profile.logoutBody: You will stop getting booking requests on this phone until you log in again.
profile.underReviewNote: Your profile is under review, so editing is paused for now.

catalog.title: Services & packages
catalog.empty: No services yet. Add what you offer with a price.
catalog.note: Price and package changes go live instantly.
catalog.deleteBody: Customers will no longer see it. Existing bookings are not affected.

service.title: Service name
service.descriptionPlaceholder: What's included, timings, anything customers should know
service.guestRangeError: Minimum guests can't be more than maximum guests.

package.title: Package name
package.itemsMax: You can add up to {{max}} items.

price.invalid: Enter the price in numbers, e.g. 1500.
price.tooLow: The price must be at least ₹1.
price.tooHigh: The price can be at most ₹10,00,000.

form.short: Too short — please write a little more.

business.title: Business info
business.name: Business name
business.categoryLocked: Your service type is fixed after approval. To change it, contact EventSeva support.
business.addressHint: Only the EventSeva team sees your full address.
business.aboutPlaceholder: Years of experience, what makes you special
business.aboutHint: Write at least {{min}} letters — customers read this first.
business.reviewNote: Changes to your business info are checked by the EventSeva team.

photos.title: Photos & videos
photos.guidelines: Clear photos, at least 1200px. No screenshots.
photos.reviewNote: New photos show to customers after the team approves them.
photos.noCover: Add photos — your first photo becomes the cover.
photos.previewUnavailable: Photo preview is not available yet.
photos.limitBody: You can have up to 30 photos and 5 videos. Remove one to add another.
photos.deleteBody: It will be removed from your profile for good.
photos.tapHint: Tap a photo to make it the cover, move or delete it.

docs.title: Documents
docs.subtitle: For verification only. Our team reviews within 24–48 hours.
docs.aadhaarNote: We only ever store the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar.
docs.privacy: Documents are only for verification. Customers never see them.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.note: Payouts are sent only to an account in your own name.
bank.missing: Add your bank account to receive payouts.
bank.holderHint: Exactly as on your passbook or cheque
bank.replacing: Saving replaces {{account}}. The new account will be checked again.
bank.security: Your account number is stored encrypted. Only the EventSeva finance team can see it, to send your payouts.
bank.savedBody: Our team will check it within 1–2 working days.

errors.account: Account number must be 9 to 18 digits.
errors.mismatch: The two account numbers do not match.
errors.ifsc: Enter a valid IFSC, e.g. SBIN0001234.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.payoutRule: Payouts reach your bank the day after the event (3 days for new vendors).

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.emptyBody: Customers can review you after the event. Good service brings good reviews.
reviews.replyPlaceholder: Thank the customer or answer their point politely

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Booking requests, payments and messages will show up here.

help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: Write to the EventSeva team. We usually reply within a day.
help.subject: Subject
help.sent: Sent! The EventSeva team will get back to you.
help.noHistory: You haven't written to us yet.

language.title: Choose language
language.info: The whole app switches to this language — menus, buttons and notifications. Customer names and reviews stay as written.
language.changeLater: You can change this anytime from Profile → Language.

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: Check your connection and try again.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Please check and try again.
errors.slotTaken: This date and time is already booked or blocked in your calendar. Free it in Calendar, or decline this request.
errors.bookingExpired: This request has expired — the 24 hours to answer are over.
errors.vendorNotActive: Your profile is not live right now, so you can't accept bookings. Please contact EventSeva support.
errors.bookingBadStatus: This booking has already changed. Pull down to refresh.
errors.underReview: Your profile is being reviewed. You can edit it after the review.
errors.categoryLocked: Your service type is fixed after approval. Contact EventSeva support to change it.
errors.incomplete: Complete the checklist before sending your profile for review.
errors.limitReached: You've reached the limit. Remove one to add another.
errors.otpTooSoon: Please wait {{sec}} seconds before asking for a new code.
errors.otpExpired: This code has expired. Tap Resend OTP to get a new one.
errors.otpLocked: Too many wrong codes. Please try again after 15 minutes.
errors.otpLimit: Too many OTP requests. Please try again in an hour.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Indian mobile number.
errors.userBlocked: This account has been blocked. Please contact EventSeva support.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.uploadNotConfigured: Photo upload is not available right now. Please try again later or contact EventSeva support.
errors.uploadInvalid: We could not verify this upload. Please try again.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not finish. Please check your internet and try again.
errors.mediaDuplicate: You have already added this file.
errors.videoTooLong: Videos can be up to 2 minutes long.
errors.fileTooBigMax: This file is too big. The limit is {{mb}} MB.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.warningBody: Your business will be removed from EventSeva and you will be logged out. Open bookings must be finished or cancelled first, and pending payouts must arrive.
deleteAccount.removed2: Your business profile, photos and documents
deleteAccount.removed3: Your bank details and saved settings
deleteAccount.kept: Past bookings and payment records, without your name or number, because the law requires us to keep them.
deleteAccount.doneBody: Your account has been deleted. You can sign up again any time.
